validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, independently confirmed by TWO sources that are genuinely independent of each other and of GEM: (1) QazaqGaz's own 'Company Projects' page names the project 'Строительство МГ «Жетыбай – Курык» с установкой АГРС-80 в с.Курык' ('Construction of trunk gas pipeline Zhetybay-Kuryk with installation of AGRS-80 in Kuryk village'), stating it supplies gas to the 'Sarsha' locality and 'Teplyy Plyazh' resort zone in Mangistau region. (2) The Mangistau region's official 2021-2025 socio-economic development plan (Ministry of Energy order, adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2100000784, item 115) independently names the SAME project verbatim: 'Строительство магистрального газопровода-отвода «Жетыбай – Курык» от магистрального газопровода «Жанаозен – Актау» с установкой АГРС в селе Курык Мангистауской области' ('Construction of the trunk gas pipeline branch Zhetybay-Kuryk off the Zhanaozen-Aktau trunk pipeline, with an AGRS in Kuryk village, Mangistau region'). Both name the pipeline explicitly, not a generic/aggregate mention -- this is not a GEM-only entity. DUPLICATE check vs P5783: tested and REJECTED. P5783 ('III Zhetybay-Aktau', 70.8 km, dia 529mm, cap 4.54, StartYear1=1968) is a leg of the legacy 3-string Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau trunk system (in service >40 years per Intergas/QazaqGaz press material) terminating at AKTAU. P5784 is a NEW branch/lateral (проект, target commissioning Q4 2022 per the government plan) that splits off the same trunk near Zhetybay but terminates at KURYK, a distinct town ~70-85 km away in a different direction, feeding a dedicated AGRS-80 for local/resort gas supply. Different terminus, different vintage (2022+ vs 1968), independent government-plan line item with its own budget code (ДИ, item 115) separate from the trunk's own capital-repair line item (item 116, which explicitly covers Du 529/530mm rehabilitation of the P5783-type leg). Not a relabel or double-count of P5783. CLASSIFICATION: PipelineType='transmission' is supported, not a concern -- both independent sources call it a 'магистральный газопровод' / 'магистральный газопровод-отвод' (trunk gas pipeline / trunk gas pipeline branch), the standard CIS term for transmission-grade pipe; a trunk lateral terminating at an AGRS (gas distribution station) that then feeds local distribution networks is the normal transmission/distribution boundary, not a misclassification. Diameter=530mm is plausible (the parent Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau leg at this same corridor is documented at 'Ду 529/530 мм' in the government plan's capital-repair item 116) but is not independently stated for THIS branch specifically -- treat as consistent, not confirmed. FuelSource='Uzen' is reasonable: neither source addresses the branch's specific upstream tie-in, but the entire Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau system it taps is fed from the Uzen field via the KazGPZ processing plant, so continuity with sibling rows is not a defect.

validity.recommendation: Route to Update: (1) LengthKnown likely wrong -- change 70.00 km to 85 km per the government plan's own figure for this exact named item, or research a third source before changing. (2) StartYear1=2021 is inconsistent with both sources and is likely too early -- the government plan's OWN commissioning target for this item was Q4 2022, and QazaqGaz's company page (dated 24 Mar 2023) still describes the project as 'реализация ... ведется' (implementation ongoing/in progress), i.e. not yet complete as of March 2023. Verify actual completion year (2022 target likely slipped into 2023+) before keeping 2021. (3) Capacity=3.60 bcm/y is unconfirmed by any source found and is implausibly large for an 85 km lateral dedicated to feeding one AGRS plus a resort/locality (a 'AGRS-80' station nominally rates well under 1 bcm/y of throughput) -- do not treat as verified; flag for a source hunt rather than accept as-is.
validity.researcher_notes: Both independent primary sources for this pipeline give a length figure, and it disagrees with GEM's: the Mangistau regional development plan (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2100000784, item 115) states the 'Жетыбай – Курык' branch is '85 км сетей газоснабжения' (85 km of gas-supply networks) -- GEM has LengthKnown=70.00 km, a ~21% shortfall. This is the ONLY quantitative length figure I could locate for this specific named project (QazaqGaz's own company page gives no numbers at all -- no length, diameter, capacity, or date), so it is a single strong government-plan source, not yet cross-confirmed by a second independent number; tier reflects that (medium, not high). On timing: the same government-plan line item targets commissioning ('акт ввода в эксплуатацию') for Q4 2022, and QazaqGaz's own project page, dated 24 March 2023, still frames the project in the present/ongoing tense ('Реализация проекта ведется') rather than as completed -- meaning the Q4-2022 target had almost certainly already slipped by the time that page was published. GEM's StartYear1=2021 predates even the ORIGINAL target by a full year and is inconsistent with both sources; likely candidate is 2022 or later (Status=operating today, Aug 2026, is plausible on elapsed time alone, but StartYear1 itself should be revisited). Diameter (530mm) has indirect support (matches the parent trunk's documented 529/530mm at this corridor) but is not stated for the branch itself. Capacity (3.60 bcm/y) has zero support in either source; both describe this as a small lateral serving one AGRS plus a named locality ('Сарша') and one resort hotel/zone ('Теплый пляж'/'RixosAktau') -- a demand profile that does not plausibly require 3.6 bcm/y of throughput (roughly the scale of a national-trunk string, not a village/resort feeder). I could not find a source giving the correct capacity number, so I am not proposing a replacement value -- flagging as likely overstated for Update to chase, per the 'do not force a number' rule.

fills.researcher_notes: Both sources explicitly call this a 'магистральный газопровод' / 'магистральный газопровод-отвод' (trunk gas pipeline / trunk gas pipeline branch), i.e. transmission-grade, tapping off the Zhanaozen-Aktau trunk and terminating at an AGRS distribution station -- the standard transmission/distribution handoff, consistent with GEM's existing 'transmission' classification.

Both sources give the pipeline's own name as 'Zhetybay-Kuryk' ('«Жетыбай – Курык»'), confirming both endpoints and that it sits in Mangistau region, Kazakhstan. Only the Kuryk end and the Mangistau/Kazakhstan location fields are stated outright by both; 'Zhetybay' as the precise start point is supported via the project's own name (both sources) rather than an explicit routing sentence -- flagged as a partial/name-level confirmation, not a route-survey-level one.

summary: P5784 (Zhetybay-Kuryk branch, Zhanaozen-Zhetybay-Aktau system): existence + classification confirmed by 2 independent sources (QazaqGaz + Mangistau regional dev. plan) naming this exact branch; NOT a duplicate of sibling P5783 (different terminus: Kuryk vs Aktau; different vintage: 2022+ project vs 1968 legacy leg). SPEC CONCERN: LengthKnown 70.00 km disagrees with the government plan's own 85 km figure for this named item; StartYear1=2021 predates even the plan's Q4-2022 commissioning target and QazaqGaz's own March-2023 'still in progress' framing; Capacity 3.60 bcm/y is unconfirmed and implausibly large for a small local/resort feeder branch. Staged 2 ref-only fills (PipelineType, Location) -- UNRESOLVED: no independent source for Diameter or Capacity.
